Maintenance.title: Diagnostics and backups
Maintenance.diagnosticsDescription: These checks read system state and never repair or change your library. Projection readiness is not a full consistency verification.
Maintenance.backendUnavailable: The backend could not be reached. Check that the backend is running and the frontend backend address is correct.
Maintenance.diagnosticRefreshFailed: The latest diagnostic read failed. The values shown may be out of date.
Maintenance.providerCheckDescription: On request, makes one real TMDB detail read and one poster read through your configured connection. TLS verification stays enabled. Credential presence alone does not prove access. This checks backend access; browser previews also require a trusted proxy CA.
Maintenance.providerCheckFailed: The diagnostic request failed. Check your backend connection and retry.
Maintenance.state_access_denied: Access denied; check provider and network policy
Maintenance.state_tls_failed: Certificate trust failed; install the proxy CA without disabling TLS verification
Maintenance.state_proxy_failed: Proxy connection failed; check proxy configuration
Maintenance.state_no_artwork: No usable poster for this probe
Maintenance.advancedDescription: Expand for verified backup commands, portable export and offline recovery instructions.
Maintenance.backupCoverage: A full database backup created with the CLI includes film metadata, editions, default-edition preferences, ratings, notes, viewing history and settings. Back up video, NFO and artwork files separately. The portable JSON export contains personal film records, excludes credentials and media, and currently has no import capability.
Maintenance.backupPrivacy: Full database backups can contain credentials and private paths. Keep backups protected and do not attach them to public support requests.
Maintenance.commandsContext: Run source commands from backend/ using the actual database path. Keep the database and its verification manifest together, and copy both to protected storage on another disk. The backup-space check is an estimate, not a guarantee.
Maintenance.dockerBackup: For Docker, stop application writers first and use the same Compose project, release file and environment-file options as your installation. This command preserves the existing data volume.
Maintenance.restoreTitle: Full database restore requires the application to be stopped
Maintenance.restoreStop: Stop all application instances, watcher jobs and database tools. Keep the data volume; do not use down -v.
Maintenance.restoreVerify: Verify the desired backup manifest. Resolve pending WAL by checkpointing while writers remain stopped, then calculate the current target SHA-256.
Maintenance.restoreReplace: Use app.migrations.restore with --replace, --target and --confirm-current-sha256. Review the target and retain the pre-restore safety backup.
Maintenance.restoreCheck: Restart the compatible build, verify projections, then check Library, Diary and default editions. Restoring an older database may trigger forward migrations.
Maintenance.runbook: The complete commands and recovery boundaries are documented in docs/rc-operations.md in the project.

CinemaDna.title: Cinema DNA
CinemaDna.intro: Explore what you have watched and how you rated it. Every figure leads back to the films and viewing records behind it.
CinemaDna.exposureBasis: Each film counts once per category, divided by all films you have watched. Films can belong to several categories, so percentages may add up to more than 100%.
CinemaDna.preferenceBasis: Your average personal rating, with each film counted once. Rankings require {global} rated, watched films overall and {category} in a category. These are display thresholds, not statistical significance.
CinemaDna.needGlobal: Rate {count, plural, one {# more watched film} other {# more watched films}} to unlock preference rankings.
CinemaDna.needCategory: This category needs {count, plural, one {# more rated film} other {# more rated films}} for a preference value.
CinemaDna.inspectExposure: Use Exposure to inspect category counts and individual ratings.
CinemaDna.coverage: Facts available for {covered} of {total} watched films · {conflicted} conflicted · {missing} missing
CinemaDna.emptyHistory: Your viewing history is empty. Record a viewing in Diary or mark a film as watched to begin.
CinemaDna.emptyFacts: No accepted facts are available for this dimension. Missing or conflicting metadata is not assigned to a category.
CinemaDna.emptyPreference: No categories meet the rating thresholds yet. Exposure still shows counts and the films behind them.
CinemaDna.emptyPage: This page has no categories. Return to the previous page.
CinemaDna.emptyContributors: No contributing films match this selection and page.
CinemaDna.records: {count, plural, one {# viewing record} other {# viewing records}}
CinemaDna.method: Cinema DNA uses confirmed, undeleted viewing records and accepted local facts. Rewatching increases the record count without increasing a film’s weight. Unknown dates count too. Removing media does not erase your history. Favorites, external scores, notes and AI inference are excluded. Film ratings represent your current rating, not a separate rating for each viewing.
CinemaDna.error: These statistics could not be loaded. Your records are unchanged.

VideoHealth.automaticDescription: Check new and changed videos when idle; sample existing files.
VideoHealth.title: Video health
VideoHealth.description: Automatically inspect stable new and changed files, then check older files in small batches during quiet periods. Container checks and full audio/video decoding have separate results.
VideoHealth.scheduleHelp: Times use UTC. Equal start and end allow all day; an overnight window is supported. The budget prevents new starts; an already started long file may exceed it while idle so it can finish. Pauses retain decoder progress. After a backend restart, interrupted checks need an explicit retry from the beginning.
VideoHealth.limits: Only original files are read. A decode pass does not guarantee audio/video synchronization or that all intended content is present. Results apply to the recorded filesystem version and expire when it changes. No repair, deletion or saved transcoding occurs.
VideoHealth.loadObservable: Scheduling uses the backend host’s available CPU and disk counters and application jobs. It cannot observe all NAS clients or disk sleep.
VideoHealth.loadLimited: Disk or CPU activity cannot be fully observed here. Automatic starts wait for a narrower allowed time window; backend counters cannot reveal all NAS clients or disk sleep.
VideoHealth.writeFailed: Could not confirm the request. Refresh the status before trying again.
VideoHealth.loadFailed: Could not load video health status. Please retry.
VideoHealth.batchPending: The library request is queued. Files will be added in small batches during eligible idle windows.
VideoHealth.versionStale: This is an earlier or unavailable file version. Its result does not certify the current file.
VideoHealth.positionUnknown: The exact error time could not be established.
VideoHealth.progressHelp: Progress is not an exact error location.
VideoHealth.reason_load_unobservable: Waiting for a narrower allowed window: load is not observable
VideoHealth.reason_worker_owned_elsewhere: Another backend owns the check worker
VideoHealth.error_media_decode_error: The container or decoder reported invalid media data.
VideoHealth.error_duration_short: Decoded output ended substantially before the declared duration.
VideoHealth.error_file_changed: The file changed during inspection; no valid result was retained.
VideoHealth.error_offline: The file is offline or absent; this does not establish damage.
VideoHealth.error_permission_denied: Read permission denied; this does not establish damage.
VideoHealth.error_boundary_changed: Media access or edition ownership changed; inspection stopped.
VideoHealth.error_read_unavailable: Reading was unavailable; this does not establish damage.
VideoHealth.error_tool_missing: FFmpeg or ffprobe is not installed.
VideoHealth.error_codec_or_tool_unsupported: This codec, container or tool option is unsupported.
VideoHealth.error_tool_failed: The tool did not complete; damage could not be established.
VideoHealth.error_metadata_invalid: Container metadata could not be interpreted safely.
VideoHealth.error_cancelled: Cancelled before a full decode completed.
VideoHealth.error_interrupted: Backend stopped or restarted. Retry explicitly from the beginning.
VideoHealth.error_suspend_unsupported: Safe decoder suspension is unsupported; retry explicitly.
VideoHealth.error_timeout: The tool stopped making progress; full decoding did not complete.
